question: Where does MSE 0.05 sit in mean readout margin on four reserved streams × γ ∈ {1, 10}, frozen × s_r=0.5? The range of those eight cell means is the BCE-pilot tolerance.

definition.margin: mean_b [y_b f(x_b)] on the current-task batch at the state train_task returns
definition.p05_p25: percentiles of the same pointwise y f; reported, not the pin
definition.naive_homogeneous: if ½(f−y)²=0.05 and f=y m with m<1, m=1−sqrt(0.1)≈0.6838 — an assumption, not this measurement. Measured mean is ~0.85; the analogy would have stopped BCE ~20% shallower in margin.
definition.tolerance: range of mean_margin_over_tasks across these cells

population: reserved Hamming, frozen × s_r=0.5, stream_ids=[10000, 10001, 10002, 10003], seed=0, γ ∈ {1, 10}
will_not_do: Freeze m* if any identity check fails.
Choose a tolerance other than the measured range of cell means.
